title: Units

help.title: About Units
help.overview: A Unit is the sellable or rentable space — the record that actually changes commercial status. Almost every sales, rental, inspection, and cost flow points at a unit. Status is not a free-text field you should fight by hand: Reservations, Sales, and Leases move it.

sections.title: What a unit holds
items: Floor (required) — that implies edifice and project. Unit type (required) from Configurations → Unit types.
Unit number and name (required) — how agents and clients identify it.
Area, shared area, net area (required); optional veranda area.
Price and price currency (required). Number of rooms and bathrooms (required).
Description, main image, galleries, videos, extra files, marketing booklet.
Outdoor and amenity flags: balcony, terrace, sea / city / lake view, elevator.
Orientation (N, S, E, W and diagonals) and construction status (planned, under construction, ready, delivered).
Optional sale and reservation commission % — override the project defaults for this unit.
Connected units — when two units are sold or shown together.
Featured on homepage + sort order — public-site highlighting of this unit.
Optional polygon on the floor plan.

sections.title: Commercial status
items: Available — can be reserved, sold, or leased.

Reserved — a live reservation holds it. Expire or cancel the reservation to return it to available. Reinstate a cancelled reservation only if the unit is free (or sold with no other reservation) per the reinstate rules.
Sold — a sale marked it sold. Handover and title-transfer continue on the sale. You cannot lease a sold unit.
Rented — an active lease holds it. Terminate (or daily job expire past end date) releases it back toward available.
Unavailable — taken off the market without a deal.
sections.body: Do not try to “type” a unit into sold or rented. Create or complete the matching reservation, sale, or lease.

sections.title: On this page
items: Filter by project, edifice, floor, unit type, status, buyer, and similar.
Create a unit — floor, unit type, number, name, areas, price and currency are required.
Open the card for media, pricing, and flags. Row actions reach reservations, sales, inspections, leases, costs, depending on access.
Generate marketing booklet (PDF) from the unit when that action is available — it merges this unit’s marketing fields.
Soft delete can be restored. Deals that already point at the unit remain; they are not auto-cancelled.

sections.title: Related records
items: Upstream: Project → Edifice → Floor → Unit type.
Deals: Lead (optional unit interest), Reservation, Sale (+ payment plan), Lease + rental payments.
Quality: Inspection, modification request, snag.
Money: Unit costs, commissions (via sale or reservation).
Typical paths: available → reservation → sale, or available → lease.
